workshoptitle: Oracle Autonomous Database 26ai Deep Data Security Live Lab

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Prepare the workspace and target PDB
tutorials.description: Open the included executable files and confirm the target PDB.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Build the Database Security Model
tutorials.description: Create the principals, sample data, view, and data grants.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Prove Employee and Manager Access with SQL
tutorials.description: Compare authorized rows, hidden cells, and update permissions.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Configure Select AI Agent and Python
tutorials.description: Install the runtime and validate database tools before model inference.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Ask Select AI Agent as Each Persona
tutorials.description: Compare model answers with the authorized database tool results.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Present the Streamlit Web Interface
tutorials.description: Demonstrate identity, prompt, tool results, and AI response in the browser.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Optional Explicit End User Context Propagation
tutorials.description: Attach a verified local identity through an IAM trusted shared application account.

tutorials.title: Lab 8: Rehearse Reset and Clean Up
tutorials.description: Repeat the demonstration or remove the dedicated workshop objects.
